_comment: Tables that may skip a rule, each with a reason. Adding one is a reviewed change: it widens a security guarantee, so say why in the pull request.

_reasons.recovery_codes: Deliberately sealed (M1). Holds bcrypt hashes of each owner's recovery codes. No policy means no app user can read or write it at all; the only way in is generate_recovery_codes(), recovery_codes_remaining() and redeem_recovery_code(), which act only on the caller's own account (G4).
_reasons.recovery_attempts: Deliberately sealed (M1). Counts wrong recovery-code guesses so redeem_recovery_code() can allow only 5 an hour. Only that function writes it.
